releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.9 contains service 0.2.5.8. Antivirus reporting now uses Microsoft Defender active Normal mode and real time status before trusting a stale third party Windows Security Center registration. This fixes machines where ESET was removed but remained listed by Security Center. Terminal burst polling, Mesh recovery, tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
